description: Lists 'Other contacts' — addresses Google auto-saved from the user's email interactions; they are NOT in the saved contact list and never appear in list_contacts/search_contacts. Give query to search them instead of listing (prefix match, max 30 results, no pagination — the warmup request is sent automatically before the session's first search); without query it lists with page_token pagination (page_size up to 1000) and optional sync tokens (request_sync_token/sync_token; expired ones fail with 410 — re-list in full). Only names, emailAddresses, phoneNumbers, photos and metadata exist here. Other contacts are read-only: to edit one, first make it a real contact with copy_other_contact. Requires the contacts.other.readonly OAuth scope — a 403 means the refresh token was minted without it.

page_size.description: Page size when listing (1..1000, default 100); max matches when searching (1..30).

page_token.description: nextPageToken from the previous page (listing only).

query.description: Search text; when set, page_token and sync tokens are invalid.

read_mask.description: Fields to return (default names, emailAddresses, phoneNumbers) — Other contacts have no more.

sync_token.description: Return only changes since this token (listing only).

name: list_other_contacts
title: List or search Other contacts
